query:
SELECT s.id, s.companyName, s.contactName, s.contactEmail, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intakeSubmissions WHERE sponsorId = s.id) as intakeCount,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rankingsSubmissions WHERE sponsorId = s.id) as rankingsCount
FROM sponsors s 
ORDER BY s.companyName;
